key_facts: UPDATED Aug 4 DAY 3 STUMPS (T+1d to res=2026-08-05; FINAL_DAY major update): Pakistan 0.34->0.76 (+0.42), West Indies 0.44->0.21 (-0.23), Draw 0.22->0.03 (-0.19); sum=1.00. DAY 3 MATCH STATE AT QUEEN'S PARK OVAL (ESPNcricinfo, CricketWorld, TheNews.pk Aug 4): (1) PAKISTAN 1ST INNINGS: Resumed Day 3 at 266/2 (Shafique 107*, Babar 86*) before Babar Azam (88) was run out by Brandon King's direct hit triggering a collapse (281/2 to 311/6; last 8 wkts for 106). However, Abdullah Shafique carried his bat for a masterful 160* (323b, 15x4, 3x6) and Sajid Khan added 30 in a 59-run 7th-wkt stand to reach 387 all out (115 ov) — a 43-run lead! Left-arm spinner Jomel Warrican took 6/112 (46 ov, including 3 wkts in 4 balls to end the innings on tea). (2) WEST INDIES 2ND INNINGS (STUMPS DAY 3): Collapsed to 103/6 (40.5 ov), leading by ONLY 60 runs! After reaching 40/0, spinners Sajid Khan (4/32) and Ali Usman (2 wkts) ripped through WI on a sharply turning, variable-bounce pitch: Chanderpaul 17, Jangoo 13, Hodge 34, Hope (LBW Sajid), nightwatchman Seales (b Sajid), and captain Roston Chase (c&b Ali Usman off the final ball of Day 3!). (3) WI INJURY CRISIS: Opener Brandon King was stretchered off with back spasms after his run-out throw and is uncertain to bat; Justin Greaves (only recognized batter left) has a leg injury that prevented him bowling; Chase has a lacerated finger impairing his off-spin. Only Greaves + Roach, Joseph, Warrican (and possibly crippled King) remain. WI bowling coach Ravi Rampaul admitted they need to somehow push the lead to 150 to have a chance. (4) CALIBRATION: Median target projects ~95-105 with 2 full days (180 ov) remaining and zero rain on Days 2-3 (89.5 ov bowled Day 3), slashing Draw to 0.03. Pakistan are ~78% conditional favorites, while retaining 0.21 on WI respects Warrican's 6/112 threat on a deteriorating Day 4 track and Pakistan's recent collapses (71/9 in 1st Test; 281/2->311/6 today).
